title: Three ways to travel
description: Three equal rounded-rectangle panels side by side show three different modes of transport as realistic photographs. The left panel shows a blue and grey electric train travelling forward on a ballasted railway track through open green fields under a blue sky with light clouds. The middle panel shows a white long-distance bus driving on a two-lane asphalt road bordered by lush green trees. The right panel shows a white passenger airplane in flight against a bright blue sky with scattered clouds, angled upwards towards the right. No words, numbers, or labels appear inside the panels.

title: Seven ways of travelling
description: Seven picture cards sit in a horizontal row. A blue bracket spanning the first four cards is labelled "Long ago" above pictures labelled "on foot", "on animals", "in boats", and "in ships", showing a walking traveller, a horse rider, a wooden boat, and a sailing ship. An amber bracket spanning the remaining three cards is labelled "About a hundred years ago" above pictures labelled "animal-drawn carts", "cars", and "trains", showing an ox cart, a car, and a steam train. The cards for "in boats" and "animal-drawn carts" have thick reddish-purple borders, while the other five have thin dark bord...

topic_name: Understanding Large Numbers and Place Value
title: After nine thousand
description: On the left, ten green rounded-rectangle tokens are arranged in two rows of five, each showing the white label "1,000". Underneath this group is the label "10 Thousands". A black arrow in the centre points right to a larger purple rounded-rectangle token marked with the dark number "10,000". Under the purple token sits the label "Ten Thousand". Across the bottom, a large line of text reads "9,000 + 1,000 = 10,000".

topic_name: Understanding Large Numbers and Place Value
title: The value of each digit
description: A place value table contains three rows and six columns. The top row begins with a blank cell, followed by five column headers: 'TTh' in dark text on a pink background, and 'Th', 'H', 'T', and 'O' in white text on blue backgrounds. Above these headers, four amber arrows curve to the left, each labeled with '×10'. The second row is labeled 'Digit' and contains the numerals '5', '2', '5', '2', and '5'. The third row is labeled 'Value' and contains '50,000', '2,000', '500', '20', and '5'. Centred below the table is the large numeral '52,525'.

title: Reading a number from its tokens
description: A place value table has five columns headed "TTh", "Th", "H", "T", and "O" in white letters on blue. Under "TTh" sit three purple tokens labelled "10,000". Under "Th" sit four green tokens labelled "1,000". Under "H" sit six yellow tokens labelled "100". Under "T" sit eight blue tokens labelled "10". Under "O" sit two orange tokens labelled "1". Directly beneath the columns, a digit row shows "3", "4", "6", "8", and "2". Below that is the number "34,682", followed by the words "Thirty-four thousand six hundred eighty-two" printed at the bottom.

title: Reading a number with zeros
description: At the top, the number "30,402" is printed in large dark numerals. Directly beneath it is a place value grid with five columns and two rows. The top row has blue cells labeled in white with "TTh", "Th", "H", "T", and "O". The second row contains the digits "3", "0", "4", "0", and "2". The cells holding "3", "4", and "2" are white, while the two cells holding "0" under "Th" and "T" have a reddish-purple fill. Short vertical lines connect each zero cell to a rounded tag below reading "not said". At the bottom is the written text "Thirty thousand four hundred two".

title: Writing a number from its name
description: A ticket with side notches contains the phrase 'Sixty-eight thousand five hundred nineteen' split across three tinted blocks: 'Sixty-eight thousand' on pale blue, 'five hundred' on pale yellow, and 'nineteen' on pale pink. Three arrows lead from these blocks down to a five-column place-value chart. The chart's header row has blue cells labeled 'TTh', 'Th', 'H', 'T', and 'O' in white text. The second row holds the digits '6', '8', '5', '1', and '9' in matching pale blue, pale yellow, and pale pink cells. Centered below the chart is the number '68,519'.

title: Zero holds a place
description: At the top, a notched white ticket displays the words "Sixty thousand two hundred nine". Beneath it sits a place value grid with five columns. The blue header row reads "TTh", "Th", "H", "T", and "O" from left to right. The second row displays the digits "6", "0", "2", "0", and "9". The cells holding "6", "2", and "9" are white, while the two cells containing "0" under "Th" and "T" are shaded reddish purple. Vertical ticks link each zero cell to a pink tag below reading "no word, so write 0". Centered at the bottom is the final number, "60,209".

title: Finding the rule of a pattern
description: A rounded amber banner at the top reads "Rule: add 300". Below it, a horizontal row of six rounded boxes is connected by five right-pointing arrows. The first four boxes are pale blue with thin dark outlines and contain the numbers "2,150", "2,450", "2,750", and "3,050". The last two boxes have a pale purple fill with a thicker purple outline and contain the numbers "3,350" and "3,650". Above each arrow sits a small amber oval pill labeled "+300".

title: A pattern that goes down
description: A central banner reads "Rule: subtract 1,000" above a number sequence arranged across two rows. The top row has four pale blue rounded boxes containing "13,050", "12,050", "11,050", and "10,050", connected by rightward-pointing arrows. A downward arrow connects "10,050" to a second row of two pale pink boxes containing "9,050" and "8,050", linked by a leftward-pointing arrow. Along each of the five arrows sits an orange oval badge labelled "-1,000". An oval tag labelled "5 digits" sits above "10,050", and another tag labelled "4 digits" sits beneath "9,050".

title: Which number is greater?
description: A place-value chart has three rows and six columns. The blue header row has an empty cell followed by columns labelled "TTh", "Th", "H", "T", and "O". The second row displays "8,965", an empty cell with a dashed grey outline under "TTh", and digits "8", "9", "6", and "5", with a tag "4 digits" to the right. The third row displays "21,304", a mauve cell holding digit "2" under "TTh", and digits "1", "3", "0", and "4", tagged "5 digits". A double-headed arrow links "8,965" and "21,304". Below, "21,304 8,965" is printed with a mauve greater-than sign.

title: Numbers on a number line
description: A horizontal number line has five equally spaced tick marks labeled 0, 10,000, 20,000, 30,000, and 40,000 beneath the line. Four pink dots with dark borders sit directly on the line, each connected by a vertical black line to a blue card with white numerals. Two cards sit on a lower level: 8,640 between 0 and 10,000, and 24,305 between 20,000 and 30,000. Two cards sit on an upper level: 19,780 just before 20,000, and 31,250 just past 30,000. Centred below the marks, the text Farther right is greater sits above a grey arrow pointing right.

title: Numbers between two numbers
description: A horizontal dark line segment has a grey circular dot at each end, labeled underneath with "71,420" on the left and "72,050" on the right. Between them on the line sit three green circular dots. Above the first two green dots, vertical lines lead to green-bordered boxes displaying "71,500" and "71,900". Above the third green dot, a vertical line leads to a purple-bordered box displaying "72,000", which connects upward to a purple pill-shaped tag reading "0 in ones, tens and hundreds". Spanning beneath the line, an upward-pointing purple brace is labeled "numbers between".

title: Swapping two digits
description: Two stacked toy trains demonstrate swapping digits. Above the upper blue engine is the number "3,925". Its four coaches consist of two pink coaches displaying digits "3" and "9", and two blue coaches displaying "2" and "5". Place-value labels "Th", "H", "T", and "O" sit beneath the coaches, with "3,000" and "900" printed under "Th" and "H". Between the trains, two curved amber arrows form a loop beside the words "swap 3 and 9". The lower train has "9,325" above its engine, followed by pink coaches with digits "9" and "3", blue coaches with "2" and "5", and values "9,000" and "300" under "Th" a...

title: The biggest and the smallest by one swap
description: Three toy trains illustrate swapping digits to form new numbers. At the top, a train labeled 62,815 has a blue engine pulling five blue coaches showing white digits 6, 2, 8, 1, and 5, with place-value letters TTh, Th, H, T, and O below them. Two amber arrows point downward. The left arrow, labeled biggest: swap 6 and 8, points to train 82,615 with pink coaches for digits 8 and 6 and blue coaches for 2, 1, and 5. The right arrow, labeled smallest: swap 6 and 1, points to train 12,865 with pink coaches for digits 1 and 6 and blue coaches for 2, 8, and 5.

title: Expanded form of 5,207
description: A place value chart has four columns headed 'Th', 'H', 'T', and 'O'. The 'Th' column contains five blue tokens labeled '1,000' arranged in two rows of three and two. The 'H' column holds two amber tokens labeled '100' side by side. The 'T' column contains no tokens, showing only a dashed purple circle outline. The 'O' column holds seven green tokens labeled '1' arranged in rows of four and three. Below each column, value boxes display '5,000', '200', a grey '0', and '7'. Below the chart, an equation reads '5,207 = 5,000 + 200 + 7', with arrows pointing from '5,000', '200', and '7' to their mat...

topic_name: Expanded Form and Tens, Hundreds, Thousands
title: Tens, hundreds and thousands in 2,745
description: At the top left, the number "2,745" appears above four column headings labelled "Th", "H", "T", and "O". Below these headers are three rows of four square boxes showing the digits "2", "7", "4", and "5". In the first row, the box under "Th" is shaded blue with a white "2", while the other three boxes are white with grey digits; to the right are the labels "2 thousands" and "745 left". In the second row, the first two boxes are shaded blue, followed by "27 hundreds" and "45 left". In the third row, the first three boxes are blue, followed by "274 tens" and "5 left".

title: The rabbit and the nearest ten
description: A dark horizontal track has eleven vertical tick marks creating ten equal spaces. The first tick at the left has a carrot labelled "4,190", the sixth tick is marked "4,195", the eighth tick is pink and labelled "4,197", and the eleventh tick at the right has a carrot labelled "4,200" enclosed in a pink capsule border with a badge reading "nearest ten" above it. A grey rabbit hops to the right above "4,197". Beneath the track, seven grey curved arrows point left from the eighth tick to the first tick labelled "7 jumps", while three blue curved arrows point right from the eighth tick to the elev...

title: Nearest hundred and nearest thousand of 6,731
description: Two horizontal roads show a grey rabbit between carrots at each end. On the top road, labels read '6,700', '6,731', '6,750', and '6,800'. From '6,731', a blue arrow pointing left is labeled '31 jumps' toward '6,700', which has a pink oval and the tag 'nearest hundred', while a grey arrow pointing right is labeled '69 jumps'. On the bottom road, labels read '6,000', '6,500', '6,731', and '7,000'. From '6,731', a grey arrow pointing left is labeled '731 jumps', and a blue arrow pointing right is labeled '269 jumps' toward '7,000', ringed in pink beside the tag 'nearest thousand'.

title: Two numbers, one nearest hundred
description: A horizontal dark grey road features five vertical tick marks labeled underneath as "5,300", "5,380", "5,400", "5,420", and "5,500". Three carrots stand on the road at the "5,300", "5,400", and "5,500" marks. The middle carrot at "5,400" is circled by a pink oval ring beneath a pink tag reading "same nearest hundred". Two grey rabbits sit on the road at "5,380" and "5,420", both facing the middle carrot. Above them, two blue curved arrows point toward the middle carrot, each labeled "20 jumps". title: Ways to travel
description: Eight modes of travel appear in two rows of four, each with its name printed beneath. The top row shows a sailboat in water labelled "ship with a sail", an airliner labelled "aeroplane", a two-wheeled vehicle labelled "electric bike", and a blue engine on a track labelled "train". The bottom row displays a white and blue coach labelled "bus", a vessel half-submerged in water labelled "submarine", a rocket assembly labelled "space shuttle", and a person on a sled drawn by four dogs on snow labelled "sled pulled by dogs".

title: How far in one hour
labels: In one hour a person can generally travel
description: Under the heading 'In one hour a person can generally travel', eight cards form two columns of four. The left column pairs pictures with 'on foot' and '3 to 5 km', 'on horseback' and '10 to 15 km', 'by cycle' and '12 to 20 km', and 'by motorbike' and '40 to 60 km'. The right column pairs pictures with 'by train' and '40 to 160 km', 'by ship' and '25 to 45 km', 'by aircraft' and '750 to 920 km', and 'by spacecraft' and 'at least 28,000 km'. The illustrations show a walking person, horse rider, bicycle, motorbike, train, ship, airplane, and spacecraft. Distances are in blue.

title: How many vehicles for 12 children
description: At the top left is the label "12 children". Below it, a top row shows 3 blue cars, each with 4 windows containing one child, for 12 children in total. Beneath these cars is the label "4 children in each car", and to their right is "12 ÷ 4 =" with "3 cars" below it. A bottom row displays 2 longer amber vans, each with 6 windows showing one child, also totalling 12 children. Below them is the label "6 children in each big car", and to the right is "12 ÷ 6 =" with "2 big cars" beneath.

title: Large numbers in a box of stickers
description: On the left, a square sheet with a dark outline contains a 10 by 10 grid of 100 blue circular stickers, labelled below with "1 sheet" and "100 stickers". A thick black arrow points right toward an open cardboard box in the center, which holds a solid white rectangular block representing a stack of sheets, labelled "40 sheets" underneath. On the right, the multiplication expression "100 × 40 =" sits above "4,000". A horizontal square bracket directly beneath "4,000" underlines the four digits, with the label "4-digit number" printed below it.

topic_name: Pastime Mathematics: Puzzles on the Train
title: The river crossing puzzle
description: A wide light blue river flows horizontally across the lower scene between two pale green banks, with two soft green hills in the background. On the elevated left bank sit three items arranged from left to right: a tied bundle of green grass labeled "bundle of grass", a golden-brown sitting lion labeled "lion", and a white woolly sheep standing facing right labeled "sheep". Floating on the river to the right is a brown wooden rowboat carrying one boatman wearing an orange turban and red shirt, holding a wooden oar, labeled "boatman". The right bank is completely empty.

topic_name: Pastime Mathematics: Puzzles on the Train
title: Pile of pebbles: 2 and 2
description: Two rows of game states are joined by arrows. The top row starts with two piles of two grey pebbles labeled "2 and 2". Following an arrow labeled "friend takes 2", it shows an empty dashed spot and two pebbles labeled "0 and 2", then after "you take 2", two dashed spots in a pink ring labeled "0 and 0" beside green text "you win". The bottom row moves through states labeled "2 and 2", "1 and 2", a pink-ringed "1 and 1", "0 and 1", and a pink-ringed "0 and 0" with "you win", connected by arrows labeled "friend takes 1" and "you take 1". A legend labels the pink ring "equal piles after your move...

topic_name: Pastime Mathematics: Puzzles on the Train
title: Subtract and repeat with 2 and 5
description: At the left, a rounded tag labelled "2 and 5" points with an arrow to the first of three vertical subtractions arranged side by side. The first problem shows "52" over "- 25" with a horizontal line and the difference "27" in a pink rounded box, followed beneath by "9 × 3". A rightward arrow connects this box to the second problem, which shows "72" over "- 27" with difference "45" in a pink box and "9 × 5" beneath. Another arrow connects to the third problem, "54" over "- 45" with difference "9" in a pink box and "9 × 1" beneath. Centred at the bottom is "all in the table of 9".

title: The king's stable
description: Twelve square stalls form a ring around an empty central space. The four corner stalls have pink shading, while the eight middle stalls are white. Blue dots sit inside stalls: the top row has 1, 2, 2, and 0 dots from left to right; the right column has 0, 2, 3, and 0 from top to bottom; the bottom row has 0, 2, 3, and 0 from left to right; and the left column has 1, 1, 3, and 0 from top to bottom. Each side has a blue numeral "5" centered outside it. A line points from the label "corner stall" to the top-left corner stall.

title: Our journey through the chapter
description: A grey road with a dashed centre line winds in three tiers, starting at an orange flag and finishing at a chequered flag. Fourteen blue circular stops with white icons are spaced along the road. The top row runs right through five stops labelled "Journeys and Big Numbers", "Travelling Then and Now", "Large Numbers and Place Value", "Read the Numbers", and "Write the Numbers". The middle row runs left through "Number Patterns", "Comparing and Ordering", "Digit Swap", "Expanded Form", and "Nearest Numbers".
